scope: R1 knowledge lesson retrieval from 60 R0 question texts; one target lesson per sample, top 5 chunks. Labels reviewed before measuring. No similarity-pair or answer-accuracy claims.
limitations: Development baseline, not independent human gold or held-out generalization.
Listening labels evaluate the skill requested by written prompts; audio answers remain unverified.
Report both sample recall and family-macro recall; repeated templates share a family. No model tuning or train/test split is performed.
R0 similarQuestionIds remain excluded; question-bank Recall and verified audio evaluation remain R7 work.
Queries omit explanations and answer labels; corpus language is Vietnamese while many prompts are English.
